summary: Long-form publishing platform under pressure from AI writing tools that replicate its output at zero marginal cost.
moat: Medium's moat is its curated distribution: the Partner Program pays writers based on member reading time, creating an incentive to write for depth rather than clicks. Its editorial curation and niche publication ecosystem attract a paying readership willing to subscribe for quality writing. However, AI writing tools produce passable long-form drafts in minutes, flooding the platform with low-quality content and devaluing human authorship.

challengers.name: ChatGPT and AI writing assistants
challengers.evidence: A 2024 study found over 60% of analyzed Medium articles showed signs of AI-generated text, threatening the human authenticity signal that paying subscribers value.
